notes.title: New version: Polar survival！
notes.notes:
New version: Polar survival
In order to avoid the zombies, the survivors fled to the port and took a cargo ship to sea. As time passed, the cargo ship finally reached the Pole. After the survivors landed, they found that there was a military base here with some facilities beyond modern times. They encountered even more terrifying zombies: Aliens.

notes.title: Game Update 002: Bug fixes and optimizations!
notes.notes:
Bug fixes and optimizations

Optimization content:
----Fixed the reward bug in the level mode. We are really sorry for the lack of rewards for three stars.
----Items can be used in the running state!
----The key to throw items in the online state is changed to Ctrl+number keys
----Because there are systemic bugs in 3~4 people online, the remote connection limit is changed to 2 people; to support more players' connections, we will implement it when we plan to create new online multiplayer online gameplay and solutions;
----Add diamond rewards to the online survival mode and settle them in the game. Avoid the problem of not being able to obtain them when disconnecting.
----Fixed multiple system compatibility issues
----Fixed some program-induced crash issues
----Fixed the last level penetration issue of the flamethrower

The next plan is to update the content! New maps, new characters, etc. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Update log 001: Bug fixes and optimizations!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I am the developer kt;
I am very sorry that the bugs in the game have caused confusion to everyone. I will try my best to fix and update.

Optimization content:
----Remove the mouse click to use the resource icon, use the keyboard [1 2 3] corresponding operation to avoid accidental touch when the mouse is aimed at the zombie below
----Replace the gun change key with the space bar
----Fix the problem of shooting at the same time when purchasing from the vending machine
----The vending machine has been changed to press the C key after approaching to open
----The setting in battle has been changed to press the ESC key to open

The performance of some firearms has been enhanced
----Crossbow
----Laser launcher
----Electric crossbow
----Gatling
----Flamethrower
----Barrett

The health of the frogman has been increased

The rhythm of the defense mode has been optimized.
